== Summary ==
The Lacey brothers of Tennessee (Ray, l. and [[Ben Lacey|Ben]], r.) face off in a Star Trek CCG World Finals game. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Star Trek CCG World Championship|Star Trek CCG at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
